calculation_handling.description: Where the TRCA finds a shoreline hazard limit or stable top-of-bank crossing a lot, the part of the lot below that line is left out of the floor space index calculation.
calculation_handling.gaps: The TRCA line and the area below it are not held in our lot data.

calculation_handling.description: Regulation 5.10.40.40(1) does not stop a lawfully existing building from being altered or replaced if the resulting floor space index does not increase.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs as-built floor area facts and the TRCA line, neither held in our lot data.

5.10.40.40(1).explanation: On Toronto and Region Conservation Authority lands, the part of a lot below a shoreline hazard limit or stable top-of-bank is not counted when working out the floor space index for that lot.

5.10.40.40(2).explanation: A lawfully existing building below a shoreline hazard limit may be altered or replaced without the floor-area exclusion in 5.10.40.40(1) blocking it, as long as the floor space index does not increase.
